Extend or Finalize a Resumable Bayesian PCA Fit

Source: R/mi_pca_s3.R
mipca_finalize.Rd

A fit made with keep_state = TRUE is resumable. update() adds draws to each of its chains. mipca_finalize() turns it into a finalized fit.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'si_mi_pca'
update(object, iter_sampling, ...)

# S3 method for class 'si_mi'
update(object, ...)

mipca_finalize(x, thin = 1L, prop_diag = 0.5)

Arguments

object

A si_mi_pca object. A resumable fit, from mipca() or mipca_fit() with keep_state = TRUE.

iter_sampling

Integer. Number of draws to add to each chain.

...

Not used.

x

A si_mi_pca object. A resumable fit, from mipca() or mipca_fit() with keep_state = TRUE.

thin

Integer. Keep every thin-th draw of each chain, starting at the first. Defaults to 1.

prop_diag

Numeric scalar between 0 and 1. Proportion of each column's missing values on which summary() computes Rhat and ESS. 0 is refused. Defaults to 0.5.

Value

  • update(): object, invisibly, extended in place.

  • mipca_finalize(): a finalized fit of class si_mi, as mipca() returns with keep_state = FALSE.

Details

Extending. update() continues each chain from where it stopped, without a new warmup. The rank, nu, transform, thinning, eigensolver settings and subset of the fit stay as they were. A fit of a draws extended by b holds the same draws, to rounding, as a fit of a + b draws made in one run with the same seed.

In place. update() changes object itself and returns it invisibly, so update(fit, iter_sampling = 100) needs no assignment. b <- fit does not copy a resumable fit: b and fit are the same fit, and extending one extends both.

Finalizing. mipca_finalize() keeps every thin-th draw and computes Rhat and ESS on prop_diag of each column's missing values. Use the si_mi fit it returns: the resumable fit can no longer be used.

Failures. If update() fails partway, the fit may no longer be usable, and print() says so. Fit again with mipca().

Finalized fits. A si_mi fit holds no saved state. update() and mipca_finalize() refuse it.

See also

  • mipca() to make a resumable fit with keep_state = TRUE.

  • as.matrix() for the completed matrices of the finalized fit.

Examples

set.seed(1)
sim <- sim_mat(n = 50, p = 20, beta = TRUE)
fit <- mipca(sim$input, rank = 2, transform = "logit_biwhiten", keep_state = TRUE, seed = 1)
fit
#> si_mi_pca fit, resumable: 50 x 20, rank 2, 4 chains x 100 draws
#>   next: update() to extend, or mipca_finalize() to finish.
#>         summary() shows Rhat and ESS per cell.

# 100 more draws per chain, in place
update(fit, iter_sampling = 100)
fit
#> si_mi_pca fit, resumable: 50 x 20, rank 2, 4 chains x 200 draws
#>   next: update() to extend, or mipca_finalize() to finish.
#>         summary() shows Rhat and ESS per cell.

# Keep every second draw
final <- mipca_finalize(fit, thin = 2)
final
#> si_mi fit: 50 x 20, 100 imputed cells, 400 draws
#>   next: as.matrix() with 'draw' for a completed matrix, summary() for Rhat and ESS
